description: Your conversions and commission (what you earn), grouped by day, week, month, subid, campaign or status, for up to 366 days (default: last 30). Daily/weekly/monthly series include empty periods. group_by=day,subid gives one row per day and sub-ID (for example per app) with your clicks too. Requires your own Clickwise affiliate API key on the MCP connection (X-API-Key header or Authorization: Bearer); acts only on your account.
name: get_performance_report
title: Get performance report
